svg.aria-label: Two line charts of S-parameter magnitude in dB from 0 to 3 GHz. Microstrip pair: through path falls past minus 3 dB near 370 MHz while far-end crosstalk rises to about minus 3.7 dB. Four-line bus: through path stays above minus 1.2 dB and far-end crosstalk stays below minus 37 dB.

g.text: two lines 0.4 mm apart on 0.8 mm FR-4. Far-end crosstalk climbs to −3.7 dB, as strong as the through path past a few
four lines with weaker coupling: through loss −1.2 dB at 3 GHz, far-end crosstalk no worse than −37.5 dB.
